This '''[[Jedi academy|academy]]''' was built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]], and used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was later destroyed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|destruction]] of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Order.

==History==
This [[Jedi academy]] was where [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] would train to become a [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardians]]. It was a favorite of [[Jedi ace]] [[Crix Sunburris]] during the [[New Sith Wars]]. A thousand years later, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] would use ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'' to locate and destroy the academy and the Jedi who were stationed in it, saving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] time as they hunted Jedi.<ref name="TJP" />
